reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM products
WHERE category_raw <> TRIM(category_raw)
alternatives: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM products WHERE length(category_raw) <> length(TRIM(category_raw))
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category_raw <> TRIM(category_raw)) AS n_products FROM products

other_way.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM products WHERE length(category_raw) <> length(TRIM(category_raw))
other_way.tradeoff: Comparing lengths shows that something was cut, but comparing the text with its trimmed form is the plainer test.

planted_wrong.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM products WHERE category_raw LIKE '% %'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM products WHERE category_raw = TRIM(category_raw)
